text: Entry Requirements Age: 18 to 25. Students under 18 can also apply but they might need to find an adult(your family member, relatives or friends) living in China, better a Chinese, as your guarantor in China before you can apply, and your guarantor will need to provide related documents like guardian letter for you to support their applications. And you are more suggested to apply for this university after you were 18 years old. With an educational background equal to high school graduation in China And Band 3 certificate in HSK (Examination on Chinese language level) Note: Please be noted that when you enroll in the university, you should under 25 years old.
